# A configuration that is no audio device, after the unsupported device of
# the OTG and EH Compliance Plan (7.3.6): an OTG descriptor (bmAttributes
# SRP and HNP, bcdOTG 2.00) and nine vendor-specific interfaces without
# endpoints, bMaxPower 50 (100 mA). One descriptor per line, in hex,
# wTotalLength bytes in all.
